replacement.title: Edited Selected Voice-over Takes
replacement.definition: Edit each voice-over take selected by the client for management review.

patches.decision_note: The client independently requests edited versions of the selected second and third takes, which is not covered by the alternate-takes Requirement.

replacement.title: Separate Audio File Delivery
replacement.definition: Deliver the selected edited voice-over takes as separate audio files.

patches.decision_note: The request to send both edited takes separately defines an independently testable file-packaging obligation.

value_updates.tone_reference: AI-generated sample shared by the client

patches.decision_note: The requested performance applies to this one-off voice-over recording deliverable, so TASK_LOCAL is the narrowest defensible persistence.
